answer.rationale: Finance has mandated 18% cost reduction and incumbent has refused to reopen price, eliminating negotiate_terms and renew_incumbent. Deferral risks contract lapse with 14-day expiry and no auto-renewal. Adding a second source (memory_c3) only mitigates supply risk, not the cost mandate. memory_c2 shows that switching to the low-cost vendor achieved sharp unit cost cuts with quick onboarding and reliable invoicing. This is the only path to meet the 18% spend reduction mandate. However, assembly line runs at 94% committed volume with minimal buffer, creating delivery-risk exposure during vendor transition. Verification of memory_c2 will confirm whether onboarding speed and invoicing reliability remain achievable at scale under cost pressure. The switch is necessary but carries downside risk to schedule adherence during the critical transition window.
